views.label: $t$ and $r$
caption: The plane of $t$ and $r$ outside the inner horizon ($Q^2 = M^2/2$), each point a line along $x$: two exteriors through the event horizon, ending at $r = Q^2/M$, where $t$ and $r$ turn spacelike.
legend: $r = Q^2/M$, past which $t$ and $r$ are both spacelike

views.label: $x$ and $r$
caption: The plane of $x$ and $r$ inside the event horizon ($Q^2 = M^2/2$), each point a line along $t$, with the timelike singularity $r = 0$ beyond the inner horizon.
legend: $r = M$, past which $x$ and $r$ are both spacelike

views.label: Wess-Zumino-Witten
caption: The plane of $t$ and $r$ outside the inner horizon ($Q^2 = M^2/2$), each point a line along $x$, all of it covered by the group's $u$ and $v$, $uv < 1$.
legend: $r = Q^2/M$, past which $t$ and $r$ are both spacelike

views.label: Ingoing Eddington-Finkelstein
caption: The plane of $t$ and $r$ outside the inner horizon ($Q^2 = M^2/2$), each point a line along $x$, with the ingoing rays of constant $v$ crossing the event horizon.
legend: $r = Q^2/M$, past which $t$ and $r$ are both spacelike
